title.value: Plasma phospho-tau217 for Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis in primary and secondary care using a fully automated platform
title.quote: Plasma phospho-tau217 for Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis in primary and secondary care using a fully automated platform

design.value: independent secondary care cohorts and a primary care cohort
design.quote: The study included 1,767 participants with cognitive symptoms from 4 independent secondary care cohorts in Malmö (Sweden, n = 337), Gothenburg (Sweden, n = 165), Barcelona (Spain, n = 487) and Brescia (Italy, n = 230), and a primary care cohort in Sweden ( n = 548).

n.quote: The study included 1,767 participants with cognitive symptoms

biomarker_confirmation.quote: The primary outcome was AD pathology defined as abnormal cerebrospinal fluid Aβ42:p-tau181.

intervention.value: plasma phospho-tau217 (p-tau217) using predefined biomarker cutoffs
intervention.quote: we evaluated plasma phospho-tau217 (p-tau217) using predefined biomarker cutoffs.

n_description.quote: The study included 1,767 participants with cognitive symptoms

outcomes.name: AD pathology defined as abnormal cerebrospinal fluid Aβ42:p-tau181
outcomes.quote: The primary outcome was AD pathology defined as abnormal cerebrospinal fluid Aβ42:p-tau181. Plasma p-tau217 detected AD pathology with areas under the receiver operating characteristic curves of 0.93–0.96.
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: The primary outcome was AD pathology defined as abnormal cerebrospinal fluid Aβ42:p-tau181.

primary_endpoint_status.quote: Plasma p-tau217 detected AD pathology with areas under the receiver operating characteristic curves of 0.93–0.96.
primary_endpoint_status.explanation: Plasma p-tau217 accurately detected AD pathology with high AUCs.

limitations: First, our study included only European cohorts, necessitating further validation in clinical cohorts from other regions worldwide.
Second, the slightly lower performance compared with %p-tau217 in primary care settings and among older age groups highlights the need for further investigation.

multiplicity.quote: Results were not corrected for multiple comparisons.
